title: Amethyst quartz packaging

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Distinguish product information from institutional identity, because a shopper needs to recognize both the object and its source.
strategic_value: A specimen photograph paired with the Museum’s symbol can connect a retail product to its scientific setting.
demonstration: A cube package pairs an amethyst photograph on a white front with blue naming on the side and a cyan ring pattern on top.
practical_value: Distribute image, product name and expressive pattern across separate package faces.

content_islands.name: Product face
content_islands.spec: Place the crystal photograph and blue museum symbol on the white front.

content_islands.name: Naming face
content_islands.spec: Use the blue side for the pale Amethyst quartz product name.

content_islands.name: Patterned top
content_islands.spec: Cover the top face with cyan and blue circular graphics.

reference_purposes.Application: A cube package pairs an amethyst photograph on a white front with blue naming on the side and a cyan ring pattern on top.
